pages.title: Kindness without Words
pages.text: Meals support ongoing care and cushions add home decoration options.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the configured pat action near a visible resident. A permitted pat gives a personal temporary town activity bonus; repeating it while active neither stacks nor extends it.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: A permitted native pat grants that resident a personal temporary bonus; repeats do not stack.
